correctness.rationale: The sharp row-sum lemma is derived from B^2 <= B and Cauchy–Schwarz, with a matching rank-one projection. The two-input Duhamel identity and finite Laplace first moment yield a valid global bound, and an interior all-ones perturbation of a spectrally split symmetric generator yields the lower bound through two dominated limits. Degenerate dimension and constant-filter cases are addressed. CHECK.py passed 2100 supplementary assertions but is not used for universal proof.
